context_used_percent.meaning: How full the agent's context window is

context_window_tokens.meaning: The size of the agent's context window

context_used_tokens.meaning: Tokens the agent's context holds as of its latest answer

rate_5h_used_percent.meaning: How much of the account's 5-hour rate limit is used

rate_5h_resets_at.meaning: When the account's 5-hour rate limit resets (Unix seconds)

rate_7d_used_percent.meaning: How much of the account's 7-day rate limit is used

rate_7d_resets_at.meaning: When the account's 7-day rate limit resets (Unix seconds)

cost_usd.meaning: What the agent's conversation has cost so far, in US dollars
